subject: Mutual action plan: SOC 2 evidence & GRC introductions (Aurelia Health)
messages:
From: Anita Rao <anita.rao@aureliahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Vogel <ben.vogel@aureliahealth.com>, GRC Team <grc@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps for evaluation — SOC 2 evidence kickoff

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed by the latency and routing controls. Per our discussion, we'd like to get a MAP in place that covers:

- Scope and success criteria for the eval (volume, features exercised)
- SOC 2 evidence collection timeline and the primary points of contact
- Any data handling constraints for PII/process flows

Ben (cc'd) will lead on the GRC side — I'm the technical lead and can coordinate evidence pulls. Can you propose a short kickoff agenda and who from Redwood will own each evidence item? We have a compliance checkpoint on 2026-09-15, so ideally the MAP lands and responsibilities are clear by next week.

Best,
Anita Rao
Director, Information Security
Aurelia Health

----

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita.rao@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Vogel <ben.vogel@aureliahealth.com>, GRC Team <grc@aureliahealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps for evaluation — SOC 2 evidence kickoff

Hi Anita and Ben — great to meet you both. Thanks for the clear ask.

Quick intro from our side:
- Kimberly Park (me) — Head of Partnerships at Redwood; MAP owner and primary contact for timelines
- Rishi Malhotra (cc) — Solutions Lead, will coordinate technical evidence and hand-offs
- Marissa Cole (cc) — Customer Success, will manage logistics and the evaluation checklist

Proposed 30-minute kickoff (suggested agenda):
1) Confirm evaluation scope & success criteria (10 min)
2) SOC 2 evidence inventory — identify which items Redwood will provide vs. requested artifacts (10 min)
3) Timeline, responsibilities, and next steps (10 min)

I've attached a blank MAP worksheet (Redwood-MAP-template-v1.xlsx) and our SOC 2 evidence request as a starting point. Suggested owners from Redwood for the commonly requested items:
- System architecture diagram, data flow — Rishi
- Access control and user lists (for eval scope) — Marissa
- Data retention & deletion procedures — Kimberly

Can we schedule kickoff tomorrow 08/30 between 09:00–11:30 PT? If that doesn't work, we'll do first thing Tuesday.

Action items for now:
- Anita / Ben: confirm who will be the Aurelia evidence custodian and preferred calendar times
- Rishi / Marissa / Kimberly: review attached SOC 2 questions and flag any items that need redwood legal or infra input

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Vogel <ben.vogel@aureliahealth.com>, GRC Team <grc@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T10:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Next steps for evaluation — SOC 2 evidence kickoff

Anita — quick note from the runtime/infra perspective. I pulled together the likely evidence artifacts against your PDF list and marked where we expect follow-up:

- Network diagram (internal) — Redwood can provide a redacted diagram; will include VPC/subnet layout
- Key management controls — need to confirm customer KMS integration details (if using customer-managed keys)
- Access logs / audit logs — we can supply sample logs for the requested timeframe; if you need production retention exports we'll schedule a scoped export
- Data deletion flow for ephemeral inference cache — I'll draft a short note and include it in the MAP

I flagged two items that may need legal review: cross-account log sharing and third-party subprocessor disclosures. Kimberly / Marissa, can you loop Legal if those are required?

I'll be on the kickoff if scheduled tomorrow morning.

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

- Data retention settings for embeddings and KV cache
